recipe.title: Mexican turkey stuffed sweet potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 200 C. Prick the sweet potatoes and bake them 45 minutes until soft.
Dice the turkey very small and chop the onion.
Cook the onion in the oil 3 minutes, add the turkey, cumin, paprika and salt, and cook 7 minutes. Add the corn and cook 1 minute.
Cut the baked sweet potatoes in half and fill them with the turkey mix.
Store in 4 boxes. Cut the avocado in the same prep session and add it on top.
Keep in the fridge up to 3 days and reheat in the microwave.
